system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 3. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (20 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] JULIANA (disbelieving): "Leave where?"
[b01] NOBLE MATRIARCH (cruel, scornful): "Wherever a discarded daughter belongs."
[b02] JULIANA (fierce, choked): "This is my mother's church."
[b03] JULIANA (defiant, firm): "I have every right to stand here."
[b04] NOBLE MATRIARCH (venomous): "Not anymore."
[b05] NOBLE MATRIARCH (stern, final): "Your father has chosen his family..."
[b06] NOBLE MATRIARCH (coldly severing): "...and it isn't you."
[b07] ACTION: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.
[b08] NOBLE MATRIARCH (shouting, imperious): "Guards! Remove her!"
[b09] ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
[b10] JULIANA (screaming, resisting): "Let me go!"
[b11] JULIANA (desperate, begging): "Please! Someone!"

--- WINDOW 1 (20 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] NOBLE MATRIARCH (coldly severing): "...and it isn't you."
[b01] ACTION: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.
[b02] NOBLE MATRIARCH (shouting, imperious): "Guards! Remove her!"
[b03] ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
[b04] JULIANA (screaming, resisting): "Let me go!"
[b05] JULIANA (desperate, begging): "Please! Someone!"
[b06] ACTION: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
[b07] SFX: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
[b08] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[b09] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (low, thunderous, imposing): "Take your hands off her."
[b10] NOBLE MATRIARCH (indignant, screeching): "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"

--- WINDOW 2 (21 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] ROYAL GUARD (aggressive, threatening): "Stand aside, stranger!"
[b01] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (quiet, deadly): "I said..."
[b02] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (dangerous, uncompromising): "...let her go."
[b03] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[b04] SFX: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
[b05] GERALD (frantic, shouting): "What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
[b06] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (gentle, protective): "Are you hurt?"
[b07] ACTION: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
[b08] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (firm, menacing): "Good. Then don't touch her again."
[b09] NOBLE MATRIARCH (furious, hysterical): "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"

--- WINDOW 3 (29 seconds, code score 0.81) ---
[b00] JULIANA (defiant): "Don't pretend you've earned anything."
[b01] CLARISSA (smug, malicious): "I didn't steal what was never truly yours."
[b02] JULIANA (trembling, resolute): "This was my wedding."
[b03] CLARISSA (taunting, cruel): "It was supposed to be."
[b04] CLARISSA (vindictive): "Now it is mine."
[b05] NOBLE MATRIARCH (harsh, authoritative): "Enough, Juliana."
[b06] NOBLE MATRIARCH (cold, disgusted): "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."
[b07] JULIANA (pained, betrayed): "I was humiliated by your family."
[b08] JULIANA (accusing): "And my father said nothing."
[b09] NOBLE MATRIARCH (brutal, dismissive): "Your father has made his choice."
[b10] JULIANA (choked, vulnerable): "And what happens to me?"

Pick the single best promo.
